title: Apply ACP settings to my application’s real harness
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can apply declarative provider and ACP settings while my application selects and launches its own installed harness or adapter, so I can test my actual ACP client against controlled model responses.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The consumer can select an ACP injection recipe and obtain its environment, arguments and generated configuration for applying through the application’s own process setup.
The consuming application uses its own executable discovery, launch path, ACP client, types and connection implementation. Cordyceps does not supply a required harness runner or manage shell startup.

If the selected definition lacks an ACP recipe or its required provider codec, preparation reports that configuration error without falling back to text mode. It does not probe or gate installed-binary versions.

The consumer’s real ACP client negotiates protocol version and capabilities with the real harness or adapter. Cordyceps configuration must not invent protocol capabilities; consumer tests assert the actual negotiated behavior.
